archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Diablo V Announced for Spring 2029

entries.headline: Diablo V announced for spring 2029
entries.summary: Blizzard Entertainment announced Diablo V at BlizzCon 2026. Opened reports agree that it is planned for spring 2029 and is set after Diablo has prevailed and Sanctuary has fallen; platforms have not been announced.
entries.verification: Reviewed three independent reports and cross-checked the core announcement against the opened Xbox Wire primary roundup. No unannounced platforms were added.
entries.timeNote: The Denfaminicogamer publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Overwatch reveals new support hero Doctrine as Sombra moves to support in Season 5
entries.summary: BlizzCon 2026 revealed Doctrine, a new support hero for Overwatch, for a full Season 5 debut. Reports also say Sombra will move to the support role in that season.
entries.verification: Reviewed reports from 4Gamer, Famitsu, and Denfaminicogamer; the copy retains only details supported by at least two independent outlets.
entries.timeNote: The Denfaminicogamer publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: VELVET CANDY TINT KISS announced for Nintendo Switch
entries.summary: Idea Factory's Otomate label announced modern-fantasy romance adventure VELVET CANDY TINT KISS at Otomate Party 2026. The game centers on a dangerous kiss with unusual power and is planned for Nintendo Switch.
entries.verification: Reviewed independent reports from AUTOMATON and 4Gamer. No release date absent from the evidence was added.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: LEVEL5 apologizes for generative AI in showcase footage and draws a line around shipped games
entries.summary: LEVEL5 president Akihiro Hino apologized for generative-AI material used in the LEVEL5 VISION 2026 II: Dreams showcase, saying it was intended to heighten the presentation. He also said the company would not directly use casually generated material in released games.
entries.verification: Reviewed the AUTOMATON report and cross-checked the apology and product-use boundary against the opened independent IGN report.
entries.timeNote: The AUTOMATON publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves adds Kim Kaphwan on September 24
entries.summary: SNK announced that Season 3 DLC fighter Kim Kaphwan will launch for Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves on September 24, 2026.
entries.verification: Reviewed the Gematsu report and cross-checked the character, DLC status, and date against the opened independent 4Gamer report.
entries.timeNote: The Gematsu publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Genshin Impact Version 7.1 launches September 23
entries.summary: Gematsu reports, citing miHoYo, that Genshin Impact Version 7.1, A Requiem for the Underworld, will launch on September 23, 2026.
entries.verification: Reviewed the Gematsu article. It attributes the announcement to developer miHoYo, but the corresponding primary page was not opened in the packet, so this remains a media relay of an official announcement.
entries.timeNote: The Gematsu publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: STARCRAFT returns as an open-world shooter
entries.summary: Blizzard Entertainment announced a new STARCRAFT game at BlizzCon 2026. The opened primary roundup and media report describe it as a story-driven open-world shooter planned for 2030; platforms have not been announced.
entries.verification: Reviewed the Gematsu report and cross-checked the genre and year against the opened Xbox Wire primary roundup. A more specific date supported by only one source was omitted.
entries.timeNote: The Gematsu publication time converted to Beijing time falls within the fixed window.

entries.headline: 山食いドワーフ: Mountain-eating Dwarf adds Japanese and Korean support in v1.5.0
entries.summary: Green Wizard released v1.5.0 for the Steam incremental mining game, adding Japanese and Korean text support and late-game stability fixes.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report records the developer update and localization changes.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Caligula creator Takuya Yamanaka looks back on the game's origins and focused low-budget design
entries.summary: AUTOMATON interviewed Takuya Yamanaka and collaborators about Caligula's planning background, development constraints and focus on distinctive strengths.
entries.verification: The opened interview directly supports the production-history and design-process summary.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Caligula creator discusses UN:Me's four-soul system and anxiety theme
entries.summary: A second AUTOMATON interview covers UN:Me's project origins, its four-souls-in-one-body system and anxiety as a central design theme.
entries.verification: The opened interview directly supports the stated systems and creative framing.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA launches April 22, 2027; White Len confirmed
entries.summary: Aniplex says MELTY BLOOD: TWI-LUMINA will launch April 22, 2027 across PlayStation, Xbox One, Nintendo Switch/Switch 2 and PC, with White Len confirmed.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report relays Aniplex's announcement.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.

entries.headline: Romancing SaGa 3: Destiny United drops the original Commander Mode
entries.summary: A developer Q&A on Square Enix's official stream confirmed the remake will not retain the original Commander Mode and will adjust the related Sara battle sequence.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report records producer Shinichi Tamura's answer from the official stream.
entries.timeNote: The source timestamp falls inside the fixed Daily window.
